In the 2nd day of Total Chess Championship Group stage, an incredible battle took place - World no.1 Magnus Carlsen was up against the youngest player to become a Grandmaster, Abhimanyu Mishra. What followed was two absolutely amazing games! In this video, we take you through what happened in the day and the emotions of the players on and off the board.
Video: ChessBase India
Shot by: Abhyudaya Ram, Himank Ghosh
Edited by: Himank Ghosh
